style.styleTitle: Baby's First Personalised Christmas Bauble by No Ordinary Gift
style.toneOfVoice: A delicate glass bauble, perfect for marking their magical First Christmas. The bauble is printed with an elegant white design across 3 lines of text, all of which can be personalised. The first line is printed in a hand-written style script font and is the ideal space for the child’s name, the following line of text is printed in a rustic serif font and is perfect for a custom message such as “First Christmas and finally there is a smaller space on the third line for the year. The text will be printed exactly as entered in the personalisation field provided in white ink onto a clear polyester sheet, which is then inserted into the bauble. The bauble is finished with a grosgrain hanging ribbon in a choice of colours and measures approximately 8 x 8 cm.
